thesis: SIBN is a post-earnings re-rated med-tech name holding its 2026-11-03 gap, with price above SMA20/50/200, RS63 +0.35 and the last session up 4.4% on about 1.9x average volume. Fundamentals support it but are not exceptional: revenue +14.5% YoY, a narrowing loss, 79.4% gross margin, low dilution risk and no earnings inside the horizon. The risk-off tape and nearby resistance at 25.92 cap conviction, so this is a small, dip-only long: the entry zone is narrowed from the card's 24.0-24.8 to 24.0-24.4 (the card's preferred dip area), because at the 24.77 last close reward/risk is only about 1.29, while at the 24.4 entry it is about 1.77.
invalidation: A daily close below 22.65 (under the 22.72 swing low), or a close back below the 20-day SMA (~23.5) on rising volume.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (VIX percentile 0.981, QQQ below 50/200-day) can drag high-beta small caps regardless of stock-specific strength
Resistance at the 25.92 52-week high and an analyst mean target of 26.78 sit below the 27.5 target
